# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurship and self-directed projects.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Tool](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): Orchestrator for Claude Code that automates software development with agentic features and dependency management.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color theory principles including wheels, harmony schemes, and perceptual color spaces.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canals to invasion novels to spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container's Impact](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade, eliminated dock labor, and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Comprehensive guide to sourdough fermentation, microbiology, and baking chemistry explained clearly.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial movements using mechanical gears.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits similar to human speech development.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and why Web Mercator dominates online mapping.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage, and how glowing jellyfish revolutionized biology research.
- [Roman Concrete Durability](https://www.justinhe.com/i): Why Roman concrete structures survive millennia while modern concrete fails faster through self-healing mechanisms.
